name: Newington Fair Shopping Center
summary: Newington Fair Shopping Center is a well-positioned community retail destination on Berlin Turnpike in Newington, Connecticut, offering convenient access to national retailers and services. The open-air center serves the Greater Hartford area with a practical mix of shopping and dining options in a highly visible location.
demographics: Newington Fair Shopping Center serves a diverse middle-class demographic in the Greater Hartford area, attracting families and working professionals from Newington and surrounding Connecticut communities. The trade area encompasses households with median incomes ranging from $60,000 to $90,000, with a strong representation of homeowners aged 35-65 seeking convenient access to everyday shopping needs. The center draws value-conscious shoppers who appreciate the mix of national retailers and service providers in a practical, accessible location along the busy Berlin Turnpike corridor.
description: Newington Fair Shopping Center stands as a prominent community retail destination along the Berlin Turnpike in Newington, Connecticut, serving the Greater Hartford metropolitan area. This well-established open-air shopping center has become a cornerstone of the local retail landscape, offering residents convenient access to a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and essential services. The center's strategic location on one of Connecticut's busiest commercial corridors ensures high visibility and easy accessibility for shoppers throughout the region. With its practical layout and ample parking, Newington Fair provides a comfortable shopping experience that caters to the everyday needs of families and professionals alike. The property is professionally managed by DLC Management Corp, ensuring consistent maintenance and tenant relations that keep the center operating smoothly for both visitors and retail partners.
